notes: Batch 4 «آزمون، داشبورد و امروز» (v1.11.63) — Groups 06+07 of the grouped audit. (1) PR5: the budget editor's deletes (subtopic, subject, chapter, topic) now ask first + a 5-second «بازگردانی» undo toast; the stats-modal subject delete was verified already guarded (confirm + 5s undo, v1.11.41). (2) م-۴: after an exam result is saved, a toast names the weakest subject (most wrong answers) + the compensation plan's box count, with «مشاهده و اعمال» applying it through the I-6 undo point; no plan/no subject rows → plain «saved» toast. (3) م-۵ «هدف مرحله‌ای»: an adjustable target % (default 80%) per subject in the stage report; the exam-week bar shows the subject furthest below target («شیمی ۶۰٪ از هدف ۹۰٪ — ۱۲ تست مانده»). Targets are percentages only — no rank/taraz estimation ever. (4) M-UI4: the «ثبت نتیجه» bar gets a «بعداً» button (hides until a result is recorded); recording a result clears the dismissal. (5) L-UI3: «از دیروز تا حالا» has a title + four labeled rows; the backlog delta is «کمتر/بیشتر» in success/warning colour, not an arrow. (6) L-UI4: SVG pin/moon icons in the exam-week bar (no emoji), a «محل:» label, and the review checkbox reads «مرور بودجه آزمون را انجام دادم». (7) ب-۳: the next-exam KPI shows the forecast verdict + required pace. (8) ب-۱۰: a ticked box's test fields collapse to one summary line («۲۵ تست · ۲۰ درست», «ویرایش» reopens them in place); the manual minute fields hide; the one-line row shows the test numbers too. (9) Dashboard declutter: «دسترسی سریع» removed (sidebar does the job); «هفته در برابر هفته قبل» and «رکوردهای شخصی» moved to Analytics; «۳ روز آینده» is «فردا» now; the Today summary card is per-subject details (planned, done/total, tests) and the hero keeps the live day numbers. (10) خ-۱ «شروع روز»: the first undone box today + its timer + what comes after, one card. (11) خ-۲: after a tick in the Today view, focus moves to the next undone box (smooth scroll only when out of view + 2.5s highlight). (12) خ-۳: the test counter is a +/− stepper next to «انجام‌شده» with «همه درست» / «نیمی درست» quick buttons; the typing field stays. (13) م-۷ «کلاس زنده»: an optional «لینک کلاس» field in the edit modal (class boxes only; local-only, never pre-filled, never sent to the calendar), a «ورود به کلاس» button 15 minutes before the class, and a 15-minute reminder «کلاس زنده شروع می‌شود». New state keys examTargets + classLinks (sanitized server-side). PR1 is NOT fixed here — the seq/ETag design is v1.11.67. i18n 1393/1393 (31 new keys).
